scope: Immutable company closure snapshots, monthly consolidation, and laboratory trend analytics.
changes: Company closure reports now freeze operational summaries at close time.
A person's monthly closure consolidates task, activity, transfer, and report snapshots from closed company units instead of rereading live work rows.
Laboratory monthly analytics read complete monthly closures only; open periods are excluded and filtered operational load is omitted when snapshots cannot support a comparable calculation.
Trend controls remain available while fewer than two closed periods exist, with a clear empty-state explanation.

focusedTests.coverage: Frozen closure remains unchanged after live task/activity mutations; open periods are omitted from analytics; operational weights do not inflate deliverable points.

fullSuite.note: A final focused regression after the full suite confirmed operational weights remain excluded from deliverable points.
